title: Assistant Professor of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Supattriya Chutinan is an assistant professor in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences at Harvard School of Dental Medicine. Her work focuses on operative dentistry, dental materials, and cariology, with an emphasis on improving clinical decision-making in caries management and restorative care. Chutinan is actively engaged in both teaching and research, contributing to the education of predoctoral students while advancing evidence-based approaches to restorative dentistry. Her research explores the evaluation and application of dental materials and strategies to support effective, patient-centered treatment planning. She has received recognition for her commitment to teaching and mentorship at Harvard School of Dental Medicine. As a recipient of a Shore Faculty Development Fellowship, Chutinan has pursued work examining clinical decision-making in caries management. Her scholarly contributions include peer-reviewed publications in the areas of restorative dentistry and dental materials, reflecting her ongoing efforts to integrate research with clinical education.
